english.title: Hire a cab with intent to avoid paying fare
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) hired a cab, knowing or having reason to believe that you could not pay the lawful fare or with intent to avoid payment of the lawful fare
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(a) of the London Cab Act 1896.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
hired a cab
knowing or having reason to believe that you could not pay, OR with intent to avoid payment of, the lawful fare

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) 'cab' shall mean any hackney carriage within the meaning of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 14 days imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale in addition to the lawful fare

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level one on the legislative standard scale
